main_text.p: & longo tempore prauas affectiones pignat. Recentes enim carnes plus roboris afferre corporibus praeter Hippocr. rationem 2. de diaeta (vbi recentia omnia plus virium aliis praebere dicit, eo quod viuenti sint proximiora, vieta vero & marcida recentibus excernantur magis, quod ad putredinem proximè accedant) bruta omnia carniuora demonstrant, quae carnes recentissimas, immo calentes & quasi viuentes comedentia omnium aliorum sunt robustissima. Verum aliquam hic rationem habendam, tum hominum edentium, tum carnium edendarum etiam, patescet ex speciali singulorum tractatione: in generalibus hisce non sine ratione praemissis, haud pigebit nec poenitebit paululum immorari lectorem.
main_text.head: De Leonina, Elephantina, Camelina, Pantherina, Vrsina, & Lupina carne.
main_text.p: Griephagos Æthiopia gentem, Pantherarum carnibus atque Leonum vi&ctitasse, sicut & orientis populos quosdam Africae leonina, vera historia proditum est. Solinus c.33. Plin. l.6. c.30. Elephantos similiter in vi&ctu quorundam Nomadum frequentes fuisse idem testis est.

page.notes: Transcription uncertainties: the signature "Dd 3" appears at the foot ("Dd s"); the printed word "ani-" is cut at the line end and continues on the next page. Several long-s forms have been rendered as plain s. Greek word "Griephagos" and "Æthiopia" are read from the scan with doubt; the Greek term for the Ethiopian people is printed in Latin letters here, which may be a transcription compromise. Several words in the italic passage are uncertain and not marked with [?] because they are read clearly enough from the scan.
